verdict.rationale: Cline is itself a coding agent (VS Code/JetBrains extension, CLI, headless automation); the MCP evidence (cline-docs-16) shows Cline acting as an MCP client consuming external MCP servers, not Cline exposing itself as an MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role rule, this axis is out of scope for an agent product unless it documents running as an MCP server, which is absent here.
